description: Use this for what an area is like around a new home, a development or a place: sold house prices nearby, flood and other risks, crime per 1,000 residents against the council, road and rail noise against the WHO guidelines, broadband and full fibre, indoor mobile signal, air quality, the nearest schools with their Ofsted judgement, shops, parks, GP and station distances, walk and transit scores, local pay and jobs, or the journey time by road or on foot to a place (journey_to). Returns only the measures asked for. Describes places, never who lives there. Schools are held for England only.

home.description: A home or development page address from a search. Give this or place.

journey_to.description: A place to time the journey to from a home: a town, station or postcode.

place.description: A town, postcode district or full postcode, when no home is named.

name: area_facts
title: Area facts
